title: docs(plugin-timeline): spell the README's schema-driven node `type: 'timeline'` (objectui#10824)
body:
Fixes #10824
Clause-②: no

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-timeline/README.md`, "Schema-Driven Usage": the node is respelled `type: 'timeline'` (was `component: 'timeline'`). That is the only byte that moves on the page. The rest of the example already fits the item element PR objectui#10822 declared: `variant: 'vertical'` selects the feed arm, and each item carries only `time`, `title`, `description` and `variant: 'success'`. None of the keys PR objectui#10840 retired (`events` / `orientation` / `position`) appear anywhere in this README.
- New pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/timeline-readme-schema-example-10824.test.ts`. On every run it extracts the block from the README: the section is bounded by its own `##` heading, fence pairing uses `openFence` / `closesFence` from `scripts/markdown-fence-scan.mjs`, and the side-effect import line is dropped before the literal is evaluated. It then asserts three things:
  1. the extractor finds exactly one `const schema` document, so an empty extraction cannot pass as a clean page;
  2. `safeValidateSchema` accepts that document (the triage's criterion, the call `objectui validate` makes);
  3. `StrictAnyComponentSchema` accepts it too, so every taught key is declared. The tolerant face is `.passthrough()` and would also accept `type` plus a stray `component`.
- The pin lives in `packages/types`, not `packages/plugin-timeline`. The first placement failed that package's `type-check` with TS2591 on `node:fs`, because `packages/plugin-timeline/tsconfig.test.json` names no `node` types. That same reason already keeps that package's `metaFields` source pin elsewhere. `packages/types` names `node` types, owns both faces, and already reads another plugin's README the same way (`calendar-flat-color-allday-8466.test.ts`).
- `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`: an ADJUDICATED row for the new test (`reads: packages/plugin-timeline/README.md`). `--audit` reported it as `unadjudicated-test` until the row was added.
- `.changeset/10824-timeline-readme-schema-node.md`: `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-timeline`, because the README ships in its `files`. `check-changeset-presence` asks for a changeset because the new test sits under `packages/types/src`.

## Measured

Both faces, read through the real schemas:

| document | `safeValidateSchema` | `StrictAnyComponentSchema` |
|---|---|---|
| README as it was (`component: 'timeline'`) | `invalid_union @ type` | `invalid_union @ type` |
| README respelled (this PR) | OK | OK |
| respelled plus a stray `component: 'timeline'` | OK | `unrecognized_keys @ (root)`, key `component` |
| respelled plus an item `date` | OK | `unrecognized_keys @ items.0`, key `date` |
| `{ type: 'zz-not-a-type-10824' }` (control: the tolerant face is no catch-all) | `invalid_union @ type` | `invalid_union @ type` |

Runtime, measured once with a throwaway probe (deleted, not committed): the real `SchemaRenderer` plus the registry that `import '@object-ui/plugin-timeline'` performs. The respelled document renders `1/15/2024Project StartedKickoff meeting`: bare `timeline` resolves to `view:timeline`, which draws authored `items`. The old spelling renders the registry's `Unknown component type` panel (OBJUI-001).

Once the respelling lands, `check:doc-types` also sees this node. Before, a node spelled `component` had no `type` literal for it to judge. Control: with the README temporarily mutated to `type: 'timeline-zz10824'`, `node scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` exits 1 with `unregistered-doc-type` on this README, and the file was restored to blob `8882462c0f5c`.

## Ablation (from committed HEAD `3351637fc`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored to HEAD blob `8882462c0f5c` with `git diff HEAD` empty)

- **Leg A**: anchor `  type: 'timeline',` is replaced by `  component: 'timeline',` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changes). Pin result: `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`. The tolerant and strict legs both fail with `invalid_union @ type`, and the extraction leg stays green, so the red is not an extraction miss.
- **Leg B**: a stray `component: 'timeline'` is planted beside `type` (anchor on the `variant` / `items` lines, 1 to 0). Pin result: `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. Only the strict leg fails (`unrecognized_keys @ (root)`, key `component`), so the strict leg is live on its own.
- **Restored**: `Tests 3 passed (3)`.

Two earlier plant attempts don't count as runs. One was refused by the tool because its replacement contained its anchor (anchor 1 to 1), so no test ran. The other also mistyped `variant` and was re-run as Leg B.

## Verification (all at `3351637fc` unless noted)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: green. `tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` counts the pin once, so the test program compiles it.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: `Test Files 254 passed (254)`, `Tests 5446 passed (5446)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-timeline type-check` and `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-timeline/`: green, `Test Files 32 passed (32)`, `Tests 350 passed (350)`. The earlier red at `0f834d1b1` was the pin's first placement, which is why it moved.
- `scripts/__tests__`, 53 files: `Test Files 53 passed (53)`, `Tests 2039 passed (2039)`. The set is (1) every test the markdown-test-inputs ledger lists as reading `packages/**` or root markdown, (2) every test naming `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` (this diff edits that script), and (3) the test-source scanners and changeset-gate suites.
- Install-free gates, all exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `-claims`, `-no-major`, `-overwrite`, `-fixed`; `check-control-bytes`; `check:doc-types`; `check-prompt-component-keys`; `check-doc-example-ids`; `check-doc-fence-languages`; `check-doc-links`; `check-doc-expression-carriage`; `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new); `check-test-path-roots`; `check-lint-coverage`; `check-type-check-coverage`; the three `check-vi-mock-*` gates; `markdown-test-inputs --audit`; `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`; `check-pending-changeset-literals`; `check-entry-guard`; `check-i18n-en-drift`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the four paths reports an ordinary pull request.
- Built gates (after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'`, 39/39): `check:readme-exports` OK, `check:doc-snippets` OK (678 of 678 blocks judged, 0 failed; this README is not in `UNGATED_DOCS`), `check:doc-examples` OK.
- ESLint over the two changed code files (`--format json`): 2 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population is those two files, neither of which is ignored. `eslint.config.js` configures no type-aware linting (no `projectService` / `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The runtime owner of bare `timeline` is `view:timeline` (the object-bound renderer), not the presentational `plugin-timeline:timeline`. The respelled example renders through it because authored `items` are drawn. I measured this and changed nothing.
- `packages/plugin-timeline/tsconfig.test.json` has no `node` types, so no pin in that package can read a file. This is an observation, not a defect.
- The two commits on this branch carry a model-named `Co-Authored-By` trailer. That is reported, not rewritten, because this repository forbids force-push.
